name: prom-label-budget
user: Observability engineer reviewing exported series labels before relabeling.
pain: Estimate observed series collisions when dropping a dimension without sending production labels to a service.
smallest_capability: Deduplicate normalized series, count metric and label cardinality and simulate a drop-label projection, with collision-group counts.
acceptance: Duplicate series do not inflate counts.
Metric names remain distinct after projection.
demand: Inferred from Prometheus high-cardinality guidance and maintained cardinality tooling; no verified user request.
distinctness: Works on metric-series identity; existing tabular and trace tools do not simulate series projections.
limits: No scraping, PromQL, TSDB memory prediction, storage savings or semantic value aggregation.
publication: Public alpha; final default-branch launch status recorded in portfolio index
